name: Two Two Boys
description: The Two Two Boys are a Folk Nation street gang founded in 1976 near 22nd and California in Chicago's Marshall Square neighborhood, with roots as the 'Almighty 22nd Boys' possibly dating to the mid-1960s. They were early allies of Satan Disciples, Ambrose, and Two Six, forming a notable '226' alliance with Two Six that collapsed violently in November 1986. The gang expanded into suburban Cicero in 1980 alongside Imperial Gangsters and Two Six, and later into Countryside in 1993.
